gate3_5EntryCriteria: Confirm ElevenLabs script-scoped Brush-up feasibility for the intended plan.
Confirm ElevenLabs delete and cleanup semantics for normal cloned voices and future script-scoped Brush-up variants/material.
Confirm ElevenLabs retention and deletion semantics enough for Brush-up consent, revoke, account deletion, Privacy Policy, and Store disclosure.
Confirm ElevenLabs cost, latency, and retry behavior enough to decide whether Vercel Route Handlers are sufficient.
Confirm NATIVE_MINUTE_DISABLE_ELEVENLABS env presence and safe operation proof.
Confirm Supabase account deletion cleanup proof plan covers Brush-up material, script-scoped variants, generated Brush-up audio, saved pins, and provider cleanup.
Confirm protected replay for the normal path or schedule it as the first proof during Gate 3.5.
notes: OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL is optional in the current repo and defaults when absent.
OpenAI and Azure kill switch gaps should be closed before Gate 3 PASS, but do not block a docs/design-only Gate 3.5 planning task if Brush-up remains ElevenLabs-first.
No secrets, env values, raw provider responses, transcript body, private audio paths, provider identifiers, or billing details are recorded.
